entities.name: Bolas's Citadel
entities.description: A massive structure created by Nicol Bolas on Amonkhet and raised on Ravnica as his staging ground for the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon planeswalker who built the citadel and invaded Ravnica to harvest planeswalker sparks. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the citadel was originally located, in Naktamun.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Bolas invaded.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The place on Amonkhet where the citadel originally stood.

entities.name: Tenth District Plaza
entities.description: The Ravnican plaza out of whose northern end the citadel was raised.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The climactic conflict on Ravnica.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Bolas's spell, overseen from the citadel, that stole planeswalker sparks.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Bolas's lieutenant who led the Dreadhorde and later turned it against him. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Bolas's lieutenant who controlled the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's undead army led by Liliana.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Led a battalion of Boros angels in the first assault on the citadel.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who tried to slay Bolas with the Blackblade and sacrificed himself to save Liliana. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: The weapon Gideon used against Bolas; it shattered.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: Her spear struck Bolas.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Resurrected, he threw Hazoret's spear at Bolas.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God-Eternal who harvested the sparks and was torn apart.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Bolas's twin brother who banished him to the Meditation Realm. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who concealed the truth with an illusion of Bolas's disintegration. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Where Bolas was banished.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Where Gideon's breastplate was planeswalked.

events.summary: Bolas raises the citadel out of the Tenth District Plaza on Ravnica.
events.quote: Bolas raised the citadel directly out of the northern end of the Tenth District Plaza

events.summary: Bolas directs the war from the citadel while Liliana leads the Dreadhorde and Tezzeret controls the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: Liliana leading the Dreadhorde at the base of the citadel

events.summary: Boros angels led by Aurelia assault the citadel and are repelled.
events.quote: a battalion of Boros angels led by Aurelia , but they were swiftly repelled

events.summary: Gideon attempts to slay Bolas with the Blackblade; the attack fails and the weapon shatters.
events.quote: Gideon Jura later made a desperate attempt to slay Bolas using the Blackblade

events.summary: Liliana turns the Dreadhorde against Bolas, breaking her contract.
events.quote: Liliana defied Bolas by turning the Dreadhorde against him

events.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself, transferring his protective magic to Liliana.
events.quote: Gideon, sacrificing himself, transferred his protective magic to Liliana

events.summary: Bolas is struck by Hazoret's spear thrown by Niv-Mizzet, and Bontu harvests the sparks and is torn apart.
Ugin banishes Bolas to the Meditation Realm while Jace conceals the truth with an illusion.
events.quote: Bolas was ultimately banished to the Meditation Realm by his twin brother Ugin

events.summary: Surviving planeswalkers gather at the citadel to honor Gideon and planeswalk his breastplate to Theros.
events.quote: gathered one final time to honor Gideon's sacrifice

relations.note: Created it as part of his grand design.
relations.quote: It was created by the Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas
His lieutenants, Liliana Vess and Tezzeret , operated at his command
His lieutenants, Liliana Vess and Tezzeret , operated at his command
